001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import java.util.Collection;
005import java.util.Iterator;
006import org.clafer.collection.ArrayIterator;
007import org.clafer.common.Check;
008
009/**
010 * Product type.
011 *
012 * @author jimmy
013 */
014public class ProductType implements Iterable<AstClafer> {
015
016    private final AstClafer[] types;
017
018    public ProductType(AstClafer... types) {
019        this.types = Check.noNullsNotEmpty(types);
020    }
021
022    public int arity() {
023        return types.length;
024    }
025
026    public AstClafer get(int index) {
027        return types[index];
028    }
029
030    public AstClafer[] getProduct() {
031        return types;
032    }
033
034    public boolean isClaferType() {
035        return types.length == 1;
036    }
037
038    public AstClafer getClaferType() {
039        assert isClaferType();
040        return types[0];
041    }
042
043    public boolean isPrimitive() {
044        return types.length == 1 && types[0] instanceof AstPrimClafer;
045    }
046
047    public boolean isBool() {
048        return types.length == 1 && types[0] instanceof AstBoolClafer;
049    }
050
051    public boolean isInt() {
052        return types.length == 1 && types[0] instanceof AstIntClafer;
053    }
054
055    public boolean isString() {
056        return types.length == 1 && types[0] instanceof AstStringClafer;
057    }
058
059    public boolean isDecimal() {
060        return types.length == 1 && types[0] instanceof AstDecimalClafer;
061    }
062
063    public static ProductType getLowestCommonSupertype(Collection<ProductType> ts) {
064        return getLowestCommonSupertype(ts.toArray(new ProductType[ts.size()]));
065    }
066
067    public static ProductType getLowestCommonSupertype(ProductType... ts) {
068        if (ts.length == 0) {
069            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
070        }
071        int arity = ts[0].arity();
072        for (int i = 1; i < ts.length; i++) {
073            if (arity != ts[i].arity()) {
074                throw new IllegalArgumentException();
075            }
076        }
077        AstClafer[] product = new AstClafer[arity];
078        for (int i = 0; i < product.length; i++) {
079            AstClafer[] attribute = new AstClafer[ts.length];
080            for (int j = 0; j < attribute.length; j++) {
081                attribute[j] = ts[j].get(i);
082            }
083            product[i] = AstUtil.getLowestCommonSupertype(attribute);
084            if (product[i] == null) {
085                return null;
086            }
087        }
088        return new ProductType(product);
089    }
090
091    @Override
092    public Iterator<AstClafer> iterator() {
093        return new ArrayIterator<>(types);
094    }
095
096    @Override
097    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
098        if (obj instanceof ProductType) {
099            ProductType other = (ProductType) obj;
100            return Arrays.equals(types, other.types);
101        }
102        return false;
103    }
104
105    @Override
106    public int hashCode() {
107        return Arrays.hashCode(types);
108    }
109
110    @Override
111    public String toString() {
112        StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
113        builder.append(types[0]);
114        for (int i = 1; i < types.length; i++) {
115            builder.append(" * ").append(types[i]);
116        }
117        return builder.toString();
118    }
119}
